policies.fit: each month M uses approvals strictly before M-60 days, delivery labels strictly before M; expanding train
policies.validation_scores: each month scored by its own model fitted at that month start; never rescore with final E model
policies.validation_labels: three complete calendar cohorts ending floor_month(E-60 days); labels strictly before E
policies.threshold: common raw score threshold across historical versions; recent, pooled, or every-month recall >=30%
policies.selection: validation alerts then FP then AP then fixed candidate order; recent uses latest month, others all three
policies.overlap: final model may train on historical validation rows, but policy uses their earlier genuinely OOT scores
policies.score_transfer: scores are uncalibrated; historical monthly recall is not a guarantee for newly retrained model
policies.cache: one fit per month/candidate; retain full-month scores and reapply label maturity for each E
policies.comparison: frozen context changes both final training recency and validation model versions; not a pure causal retraining effect
policies.evaluation_role: previously inspected development months; not a new independent test
policies.holdout: original 2018-05-26 onward period is not scored
policies.promotion: research only; original, balanced and previous research artifacts unchanged

split.training_source_cutoff: Training approvals are strictly before model_fit_time minus 60 days; training delivery labels are strictly before model_fit_time. Each fitted model and preprocessing pipeline use only this training partition.
split.scoring_source_cutoff: Scoring cohort uses only approval timestamps within the supplied valid-delivered cohort; it is not filtered by label availability. Prior event features must still use only completed events strictly before each individual approval.
split.maturity_scope: Maturity exclusions are within the existing valid delivered cohort only; cancelled, unfinished and other excluded orders do not receive inferred negative labels.

raw_train_audit.scope: raw approval cohort, final snapshot statuses; excluded orders get no inferred label
